requirements.text: CMake configuration and build must successfully compile and create the count_even executable without errors.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |

requirements.text: Validate CLI arguments, producing exit code 1 if argument count is not two, and exit code 2 for invalid numbers, numbers outside [-1000, 1000], or left > right, printing a clear message to stderr.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |
| CLI validation | 1 | Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments |

requirements.text: The program must correctly count even integers in the inclusive interval [left, right], including zero and negative even numbers.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |

requirements.text: On success, output must contain only one integer count followed by \n to stdout with no other text. On error, stdout must be empty and errors sent to stderr.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |
| CLI validation | 1 | Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments |
| Output format | 1 | Only one integer and a newline in stdout on success; stderr on errors |

criteria.title: Build
criteria.description: CMake creates count_even executable without errors.
criteria.verification_method: Run `cmake -S . -B build` followed by `cmake --build build` and check for successful creation of the `count_even` executable without build errors.

criteria.title: Correctness
criteria.description: Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values.
criteria.verification_method: Execute the binary with representative valid inputs including positive, negative, zero, and single-value ranges (e.g. 1 5, -3 3, 0 0) and verify that the count of even numbers in [left, right] is correct.

criteria.title: CLI validation
criteria.description: Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments.
criteria.verification_method: Invoke the program with invalid argument counts (expecting exit code 1) and with invalid numbers, values outside [-1000, 1000], or left > right (expecting exit code 2), ensuring error messages are printed to stderr.

criteria.title: Output format
criteria.description: Only one integer and a newline in stdout on success; stderr on errors.
criteria.verification_method: Verify that successful runs emit exactly one integer followed by newline to stdout with no extra text, and erroneous runs keep stdout completely empty while writing error messages to stderr.
